content.short: Official repository of the Core Uniswap v3 Protocol smart contracts.
content.description: Uniswap v3 Core is an open-source collection of smart contracts that underpins the Core Uniswap v3 Protocol, including licenses, interfaces, and concrete implementations. Developers can study the underlying contracts on test networks to learn, audit, or participate in bug bounty programs. The project has around 2,000 forks, roughly 3,000 active users, and hundreds of contributors who keep it active through issues, discussions, and regular updates.
